C0594.title: First Case: Streamer Jailed for Leaking Honor of Kings Skins for Profit
C0594.summary: In July 2024, the Chengdu High-tech Zone Court ruled on a copyright infringement case. The defendant, a video blogger surnamed Liu, had repeatedly released unreleased content of the game 'Honor of Kings' since February 2023 to generate advertising revenue. Within four months, Liu posted 33 leaked videos, garnering over 1.78 million likes and illegally obtaining hundreds of thousands of yuan in ad
